attributes.accessibilityText: acceptInvite can add a member twice

The member is added before the invite is marked accepted, so a link opened twice at once adds them twice: export async function acceptInvite(token: string) { const invite = await db.invites.find(token); if (!invite || invite.acceptedAt) throw new InviteError("no-longer-valid"); await db.members.add(invite.workspaceId, invite.email); await db.invites.accept(invite.id); } I'm moving both writes into one transaction that claims the invite first.
